hero.label: GLOBAL MANGA PUBLISHER
hero.heading: Japanese stories, everywhere at once.
hero.sub: Z-IP contracts directly with manga artists, localizes and animates their work through an AI pipeline, and delivers it worldwide the same day — carried by fans everywhere.

lines: Somewhere, there is a story that hasn't reached you yet.
Language barriers, staggered releases, piracy — all of it grows from one outdated assumption: that stories ship one country at a time.

engines.label: TWO ENGINES

a.name: PANEL
a.label: GLOBAL PUBLISHING
a.heading: Our own IP, delivered worldwide at once
a.body: We sign direct publishing contracts with top creators, then translate and turn their work into motion comics through our AI pipeline, releasing it worldwide simultaneously. Hits validated by real-time social data move on to anime, merchandise, and games alongside local partners.
a.imageAlt: A manga artist's hands at work at the drawing desk

b.name: CLIPYIELD
b.label: GLOBAL IP DISTRIBUTION
b.heading: We take on the distribution of IP from anywhere
b.body: We take on assignments from IP holders around the world and spread them everywhere at once through a network of local clippers and fans. A rights-holder-approved whitelist structurally removes the copyright risk that distributors used to carry.
b.imageAlt: Young creators filming and editing video on their smartphones

engines.relation: These two are not a sequence; they run in parallel. Each one's track record becomes the other's credibility, and the depth of the distribution network drives both forward.

items.title: Breaking the waterfall
items.body: Rolling out one country at a time through local agents has meant lag, high cost, and piracy. Z-IP replaces it with simultaneous worldwide release.

items.title: An official whitelist
items.body: We provide a rights-holder-approved library of assets, structurally removing the copyright-ban risk distributors used to bear. This is the single biggest reason to take part.

items.title: Day-0 fandom
items.body: From day one, fans worldwide spread the work themselves. Clippers are not subcontractors — they are co-founders of the fandom.

closing.heading: Your story, to the world.
closing.body: For those with a work to entrust, an IP to spread, or a place to build with us.
closing.imageAlt: The earth at night with a network of light spreading across the world

header.title: Services
header.intro: A publishing business that delivers our own IP worldwide at once, and a distribution business that takes on the spread of IP from anywhere. Two engines, running in parallel on one pipeline.
header.imageAlt: A production studio lined with drawing desks and monitors

panel.label: ENGINE A ｜ PANEL
panel.heading: Our own IP, delivered worldwide at once
panel.lead: A publishing business: we sign direct contracts with top creators, localize and turn their work into motion comics through our AI pipeline, and release it worldwide simultaneously.

points.title: Direct publishing contracts
points.body: We contract with creators directly. With no intermediary, decisions are fast, and we manage rights and distribution terms end to end.

points.title: Simultaneous worldwide release
points.body: Not one country at a time — every region in a supported language, at once. From day one, fans everywhere get it with no delay.

points.title: Real-time data validation
points.body: Post-release social data shows which works are growing in which countries, and informs the next move.

points.title: Media-mix expansion
points.body: Validated hits expand into anime, merchandise, and games alongside local partners.

panel.imageAltA: A manga artist's hands over a manuscript
panel.imageAltB: A close-up of a page typeset in several languages

clipyield.label: ENGINE B ｜ CLIPYIELD
clipyield.heading: We take on the distribution of IP from anywhere
clipyield.lead: CLIPYIELD sources the outcome of distribution from clippers and fans around the world, and delivers that outcome to IP holders.

steps.title: Register the assignment
steps.body: We take in the work an IP holder wants spread, and its goal, and register it as an assignment.

steps.title: Publish the whitelist
steps.body: We publish a rights-holder-approved list of assets. Clippers can create with confidence within that scope.

steps.title: Clippers spread it
steps.body: Clippers and fans in each country post clips and derivative work on their own platforms, spreading it everywhere at once.

steps.title: Measure the outcome
steps.body: We measure which posts reached how far, in which countries.

steps.title: Pay for the outcome
steps.body: Clippers are paid according to the measured outcome, and IP holders receive that outcome.

clipyield.note: The copyright risk on the distributing side is structurally removed by the rights-holder-approved whitelist.

dashboard.label: ANALYTICS
dashboard.heading: Analytics dashboard
dashboard.body: By country and by title, we visualize where things are read and spread. The same foundation informs our own expansion decisions and the reports we give on IP we take on.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: We learn the work, the goal, and the target regions.

steps.title: Intake
steps.body: We receive the manuscript and assets.

steps.title: Go live
steps.body: It goes on the pipeline, and distribution begins.

header.title: About
header.intro: Z-IP is a global publisher launching two businesses in parallel.
header.imageAlt: An office with large windows and the silhouette of a figure

mission.label: MISSION
mission.statement: Stories reach every country as fast as the one they were born in.
body: Stories don't stop at borders because of anything in the work. They stop because of an old assumption: deliver one country at a time.
Z-IP replaces that assumption. Translation, staging, distribution, and reach live on one pipeline, and the work goes worldwide from day one.
A publishing core, and a distribution infrastructure. Holding both in parallel is how we compete.

why.label: WHY TWO ENGINES
why.heading: Why run two engines in parallel
why.lead: PANEL and CLIPYIELD do not share costs. They strengthen each other through three routes.

items.title: Reference effect
items.body: The track record of our own IP becomes evidence for distribution sales, and the results on IP we take on become credibility when signing artists. Results circulate as proof for both sides.

items.title: Network effect
items.body: The more IP we take on, the more clippers register and stay active. That widens the languages and countries covered, and raises the reach available to the next IP.

items.title: Anchor demand
items.body: Our own IP pays and places orders with an early-stage CLIPYIELD. Putting paying work in front of the distribution side first is what sets the network in motion.

brands.label: BRANDS
brands.heading: Brand structure
brands.lead: Z-IP holds two brands. Their shared accent — vermillion — binds them as one group.
